claim_relevant_visible_text: Moving into 2024, SK hynix has maintained its prominence in the AI memory market. The company began supplying the world’s best-performing 8-layer HBM3E, first developed in 2023, to leading global tech giants in March 2024.
precision_guard: This later issuer statement supports that 8-layer HBM3E customer supply occurred in March 2024. It does not support an exact supply day, does not identify the customers in this sentence, and does not independently prove a named-platform qualification state.
researcher_paraphrase: SK hynix later stated that supply of its 8-layer HBM3E to leading global tech companies began in March 2024.
